rule: Up to first four eligible pre-service forks per held-back train map with multiple possible descents and slack <=7. Reuse the recorded observation of wave1. Compare against true next readings only after assigning scores.
macro_prior: Unobserved paths are simulated by locally constrained depth-first or branching trees and loop/room variants. Third likelihood includes startup resource-difference compatibility only if no station has a fully observed window.
